steps.instruction: The request is only to rename the Todo field `done` to `completed`. Do not change what `list` shows by default or how `includeDone` works. Keep the current filtering behaviour exactly as it was before the rename. Check that nothing in commands.ts still reads or writes a `done` property on a Todo (including through casts, `any`, or string keys), and that `add` and `complete` use only `completed`. If all of that is already true, make no source changes. The acceptance test has been replaced so it checks only the rename.

input.reason: The failing check was my own guess that `list` hides completed todos by default. The request was only a rename. tsc passes and every existing test passes, so the rename itself looks complete, and forcing a new default could change existing behaviour. I'm replacing the acceptance test so it checks only the rename, and asking the commands owner to make sure no `done` references are left without changing any behaviour.
